mapper.select:
select oi.id AS optionItemId, oi.extra_price AS extraPrice, oi.sold_out AS isSoldOut
from menu_opt_policy mop join opt_policy op on mop.opt_policy_id = op.id
join opt_policy_item opi on op.id = opi.opt_policy_id
join opt_item oi on opi.opt_item_id = oi.id
where mop.menu_id = #{menuId} and oi.id = #{optionItemId}
